text:
Type: square wooden side table
Use: holding drinks, lamps and books; living room, bedroom, beside a sofa or bed
Style: Scandinavian, Japandi, mid-century modern
Materials: ash veneer top, solid birch legs, clear lacquer
Colors: light natural ash, pale blonde wood
Shape: square top with softly cut rounded corners, beveled edge, four round tapered legs set slightly outward, compact and light
Feel: warm, calm, natural, crafted
Goes with: white walls, linen sofas, black accents, green plants; Scandinavian or Japandi living rooms and bedrooms

product.name: LISABO
product.description: The table surface in ash veneer and legs in solid birch give a warm, natural feeling to your room
